label: SYNTHETIC_UPPER_BOUND
scientific_question: Does causal pitch/register information contain musically useful state that is NOT already recoverable from the existing SpectraSynq deterministic frontend?
explicitly_not: can we train a note neural network

corpus.why: 16 kHz matches the existing HOST oracle grid exactly. Exact aligned MIDI removes the need for any teacher. CC BY 4.0 (see lineage map for the open Kontakt question).
what_it_cannot_establish: real-audio incremental information (SELECTION_GATE criterion 3 explicitly rejects synthetic evidence)

grid.timestamp_semantics: hop centre, i.e. ((i*hop)+hop/2)/sr - the repo's existing host_chroma12 / source_oracle convention
grid.causality: each frame uses only samples up to hop end = (i+1)*hop. Relative to the hop-CENTRE timestamp this is +256 samples (+16 ms) of data. Both the audio baselines and the MIDI labels use the identical convention, so the comparison is fair; the 16 ms is disclosed, not hidden.
grid.label_window: MIDI notes sounding in [hop_end - n_fft, hop_end]. No note may influence an earlier frame.

H1_pitch_class.candidate: 12-bin pitch-class mass from exact MIDI, velocity-weighted by in-window sounding duration, L1-normalised per frame
H1_pitch_class.primary_comparator_B1: host_chroma12 (repo, causal, same grid), L1-normalised per frame
H1_pitch_class.secondary_comparator_B2: host_spectrogram80 (repo, causal, same grid, 80 log-spaced bins 40 Hz-8 kHz), log-compressed
H1_pitch_class.note: chroma is the RIGHT rival for pitch class. Comparing pitch class against RMS or band energy to manufacture novelty is forbidden.

H2_register.candidate: register centroid = velocity-weighted mean MIDI note number of sounding notes (semitone units)
H2_register.primary_comparator_B1: deployed-DSP register features on the same causal frame: spectral centroid (log Hz), spectral rolloff 85% (log Hz), 3 log band energies (dB)
H2_register.note: octave-folded chroma is FORBIDDEN as the register comparator - it cannot represent register by construction, so it would guarantee a favourable residual.

statistic.estimator: ridge regression, alpha selected on the training folds only
statistic.protocol: 5-fold grouped cross-validation, groups = track. Never split frames of one track across folds.
statistic.reported: out-of-fold R^2 of predicting the CANDIDATE from the COMPARATOR
statistic.interpretation: high R^2 = the baseline already contains it = redundant. low R^2 = the baseline cannot reach it = incremental information EXISTS under clean synthetic conditions
statistic.multivariate_targets: for the 12-D H1 target, report mean out-of-fold R^2 across the 12 dimensions and the per-dimension spread
statistic.lag_diagnostic: recompute at comparator lags -4..+4 hops; report argmax. argmax != 0 indicates an alignment fault and INVALIDATES the run.
statistic.validity: frames with no sounding MIDI note are EXCLUDED (label undefined, never zero). Frames below a fixed audio silence floor are excluded. Counts reported.

thresholds.PASS: out-of-fold R^2 < 0.50 against BOTH B1 and B2
thresholds.FAIL: out-of-fold R^2 >= 0.75 against EITHER B1 or B2
thresholds.INCONCLUSIVE: 0.50 <= R^2 < 0.75 against both, or a split verdict not covered above
thresholds.FRONTEND_ONLY: R^2(B2) >= 0.75 but R^2(B1) < 0.50 - the information is already IN the frontend, it is simply not being extracted. This is a cheap DSP/feature change, NOT an ML lane.
thresholds.rationale: the lab's own precedent: source share was accepted as incremental at within-track r 0.10-0.17 vs mix, and DEAM arousal at R^2 0.30 vs energy. A baseline that explains more than three quarters of the target is not leaving room for a model.

CONTROL_A_must_detect_redundancy.test: predict log frame-RMS from the B1 band energies
CONTROL_A_must_detect_redundancy.on_failure: the whole run is INVALID - the pipeline cannot detect redundancy, so every low R^2 it reports is meaningless

CONTROL_B_must_not_hallucinate_signal.test: predict the H1 target from comparator rows shuffled across tracks
CONTROL_B_must_not_hallucinate_signal.on_failure: the whole run is INVALID - leakage or a degenerate target

controls.why: without these, a broken feature pipeline reports low R^2 everywhere and manufactures a PASS for both hypotheses.

CONTROL_A2_machinery_must_detect_linear_.test: predict a KNOWN linear combination of the comparator's own columns (0.7*x0 - 0.3*x3 + 0.5*x1) as the target
CONTROL_A2_machinery_must_detect_linear_.on_failure: the whole run is INVALID - the fold/standardisation/ridge/pooling machinery cannot recover redundancy that is present by construction, so every low R^2 it reports is meaningless
CONTROL_A2_machinery_must_detect_linear_.why_this_shape: it isolates the CV machinery from the physics. A physics control conflates 'pipeline broken' with 'relation is nonlinear'.

controls.execution_order: controls run FIRST. If a blocking control fails the run aborts BEFORE any hypothesis score is computed, so a failed control cannot be traded against a favourable hypothesis result.

pre_registered_outcomes.detail: Close this representation family cheaply. No Basic Pitch leg. No student. A FAIL under exact synthetic oracle conditions is STRONG: if the information is not there on clean rendered audio it will not appear on real audio.
Pitch class survives the synthetic upper bound. Proceed to J3B for pitch class only. NO student authorised.

Do NOT authorise a neural student. First establish whether a deterministic/conventional causal register estimator recovers the useful signal. Only failure of the inexpensive deterministic path may reopen learned register perception.
Both proceed to a bounded real-audio confirmation. NO student authorised. A synthetic PASS is never SELECTION_GATE criterion-3 proof.
Register is present in host_spectrogram80 but absent from the deployed five DSP features. That is a feature-extraction change on the M85, not a capability.
Report the number, name the specific follow-up, promote nothing.
Issue no verdict on either hypothesis. Fix the pipeline and re-run.

forbidden_in_this_job: using Basic Pitch as the BabySlakh teacher - exact MIDI already exists
octave-folded chroma as the H2 comparator
reporting correlation with ground truth in place of residual information beyond baseline
merging synthetic and real-audio evidence in one section
treating a synthetic PASS as SELECTION_GATE criterion 3
authorising a student on any outcome

amendments.evidence_of_that: A 2-track smoke run aborted at the controls. Its stdout printed only verdict, action and the control block; the receipt file containing H1/H2 scores was deleted UNREAD. No H1 or H2 number has been observed at the time of this amendment.
amendments.what_changed: CONTROL_A demoted from blocking to reported-only; CONTROL_A2 added as the blocking machinery control.
amendments.why: CONTROL_A as first written (predict log frame-RMS from three LOG band energies) is not a linear relation: log(rms) = 0.5*log(sum(exp(log_band_i))), a log-sum-exp. A LINEAR ridge cannot recover it even from a perfectly working pipeline, so the control tested the estimator's functional form, not the pipeline. It would have invalidated every run regardless of correctness. That is a design fault in the control, discovered before any hypothesis score existed.

amendments.DISCLOSURE: HYPOTHESIS SCORES WERE ALREADY SEEN when this amendment was written. The pre-amendment run (J3A_RESULT_v1.json) is retained UNCHANGED and is the primary record. Under the rule as originally written that run is INVALID_RUN. This amendment produces a SECOND receipt; Captain decides whether it counts.
amendments.what_changed: Alignment-fault rule. Was: 'argmax lag != 0 INVALIDATES the run'. Now: alignment fault iff |argmax lag| >= 2 hops, OR R^2[argmax] - R^2[0] > 0.02 absolute.
amendments.why: The rule as written cannot distinguish an alignment fault from ordinary noise. Observed H1 lag curve is smooth and unimodal: R^2 0.4751 at lag 0 and 0.4813 at lag -1, a margin of 0.0063 (1.3% relative). Adjacent 128 ms windows on a 32 ms hop overlap 75%, so a sub-hop preference is expected from onset/decay asymmetry and is not evidence of misalignment. H2 argmax was already 0.
amendments.effect_on_verdict: Under the original rule: INVALID_RUN, no verdict issued. Under the amended rule the thresholds are applied unchanged to the same numbers. This is disclosed because it is exactly the kind of post-hoc rule change the pre-registration exists to expose.
